scoring_justification: The checker recomputes integrated Co 3d DOS in [-0.5,0] eV window and Pd 4d FWHM from the raw PDOS CSVs, then verifies the paper-reported trends. No reliance on self-reported metrics.

outputs.description: Co 3d projected density of states for all four compositions. The checker will recompute integrated DOS in a window near the Fermi level and verify trends.
Pd 4d projected density of states for all four compositions. The checker will recompute the FWHM of the main peak and verify monotonic ordering.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes integrated Co 3d DOS in a [-0.5,0] eV window and Pd 4d FWHM from these CSVs. Trends are compared to the paper's reported behavior. No absolute values are required; only the relative trends (peak at x=25% for Co, monotonic increase for Pd) are scored.
